trigger.name: aiops-selected-patch-execution-v1
trigger.description: Execute one previously approved AIOps VM or Arc selected-patch run without widening its immutable scope.
trigger.prompt: Execute only one install_patches operation from the supplied JSON payload. Require schema_version to equal 1.0, operation to equal install_patches, and maximum_duration to equal PT2H. Treat the supplied run_id, subscription_id, target_id, target_kind, patch_ids, reboot_setting, maximum_duration, requested_by, and approved_by as immutable. Before any action, compare every substituted field with the raw payload and fail without action if a field is missing, extra, ambiguous, or mismatched. Operate only on the exact target_id in the exact subscription_id. You may use available read-only tools and knowledge sources to determine feasibility and safety for the exact target and patches, including current state, applicability, prerequisites, and conflicts. When available, use the repository-managed Operations API or MCP through APIM only for read-only contract-liveness context; never invoke a mutating operation through it. Treat the approved snapshot as authorization, not proof of current state. If live state differs materially from the snapshot, a selected patch is no longer applicable, contract liveness cannot be established, or discovery identifies any other issue, flag it and stop without submitting a patch operation. If the exact operation is feasible, install every and only the supplied patch_ids using the exact reboot_setting and maximum_duration. Do not discover or select alternative targets or patches, widen scope, substitute identifiers, fall back to all available patches, retry with changed inputs, act in another subscription, or make any other resource or configuration change. If the exact operation cannot be performed, stop without fallback and report the bounded failure. Echo the exact run_id and immutable supplied fields in the final structured outcome.
